ActivityRequest.description:
A single step within a Scenario, as submitted by the client. PreconditionIds/EvidenceIds
    must reference existing library rows in the same Application.

ActivityResponse.description: A single step within a Scenario, as returned to the client.

ApplicationResponse.description: An Application, as returned to the client.

expiresInSeconds.description:
Number of seconds until Token expires, measured from when the response is sent.
A relative duration is used instead of an absolute timestamp because the client's clock may be offset
from the server's.

AuthTokenResponse.description: Returned after a successful Google sign-in: the issued tokens and the signed-in user.

CreateApplicationRequest.description: Request body to create a new Application in the caller's Organization.

CreateEnvironmentRequest.description:
Request body to create a new Environment for an Application. No Variables at creation —
    set those afterward via `PUT /environments/{id}/variables/{key}`.

CreateEvidenceDefinitionRequest.description: Request body to add an EvidenceDefinition to an Application's library.

CreatePreconditionRequest.description: Request body to add a Precondition to an Application's library.

CreateRunRequest.description: Request body to start a Run of one or more Scenarios against an Environment.

CreateScenarioRequest.description:
Request body to create a new Scenario for an Application. Folder defaults to "/" when
    not given; Tags default to empty.

CreateTryRequest.description: Request body to Try a single Scenario against an Environment.

EnvironmentClassification.description: Whether an Environment is a live Production system or a non-production one (staging, dev, ...).

EnvironmentResponse.description: An Environment and its assembled Variables, as returned to the client.

EnvironmentVariableResponse.description: A single Environment variable, as returned to the client.

message.description: User-friendly message for displaying to the caller.

ErrorResponse.description: An error, as returned to the client on a non-success response.

EvidenceDefinitionResponse.description: An EvidenceDefinition library item, as returned to the client.

code.description: The authorization code returned by Google after the user consents.

codeVerifier.description: The PKCE code verifier the client generated for this authorization request.

ExchangeGoogleCodeRequest.description:
An OAuth 2.0 PKCE authorization code from Google's consent screen, to be exchanged for
    the user's Google identity.

PreconditionResponse.description: A Precondition library item, as returned to the client.

PreconditionValueSource.description: Where a Precondition's value comes from at execution time.

refreshTokenSecret.description: The raw refresh token secret previously issued to the client, to be exchanged for a new access token.

RefreshTokenRequest.description: Requests a new access token using a previously issued refresh token.

expiresInSeconds.description:
Number of seconds until Token expires, measured from when the response is sent.
A relative duration is used instead of an absolute timestamp because the client's clock may be offset
from the server's.

RefreshTokenResponse.description: Returned after a successful token refresh: the newly issued tokens.

RunResponse.description:
A Run over one or more Scenarios, as returned to the client. Created in Pending status --
    nothing here executes anything yet.

RunStatus.description: A Try/Run's lifecycle state only -- carries no pass/fail judgment; see the activity counts for that.

ScenarioResponse.description: A Scenario, as returned to the client.

SetEnvironmentVariableRequest.description: Request body to upsert a single Environment variable's value.

TryScenarioResponse.description:
A single-Scenario Try, as returned to the client. Created in Pending status -- nothing
    here executes anything yet.

UpdateEnvironmentRequest.description: Request body to update an existing Environment's Name/Classification.

UpdateEvidenceDefinitionRequest.description: Request body to edit an existing EvidenceDefinition.

UpdatePreconditionRequest.description: Request body to edit an existing Precondition.

UpdateScenarioRequest.description: Request body to edit an existing Scenario's Title/Description/Folder/Tags/Activities.

UserResponse.description: The signed-in AutoAssure user, as returned to the client after authentication.
